problems.intro: Most growing businesses I meet have the same six problems.

items.quote: We type the same data again and again.
items.detail: Dispatch slips become invoices, POs go into your system, bills go into your books. All by hand.

items.quote: We don't know our real numbers until it's too late.
items.detail: Sales, stock and dues sit in different sheets and different heads, so you find out what happened long after it could have helped.

items.quote: Everything happens on WhatsApp, and nothing is recorded.
items.detail: Orders, production and dispatch get agreed in chats and are forgotten by evening.
Chasing money is awkward and easy to forget, so it stays with your customers longer than it should.

items.quote: Our dealer or distributor network is hard to manage.
items.detail: Price lists, orders and ledgers live in different places, and every dealer question turns into a phone call.

items.quote: Every tool we try makes us change how we work.
items.detail: Off-the-shelf software forces its own process on your business, and your team stops using it.

process.step: Fill out the form, then a free call or Google Meet
process.label: Fill out the form
process.blurb: Tell me what you need. I reply within 48 hours by email or WhatsApp, and we set up a free call.
process.detail: Tell me which services you need. I reply by email or WhatsApp within 48 hours, and we set up a call where you walk me through how things work today. I'll tell you whether you need custom software at all, or whether a free product already does the same job.

process.label: Get a proposal
process.blurb: Scope, price and timeline in 3–5 days, fixed after the call. Setup is paid in three milestones.
process.detail: Scope, price and timeline, fixed after the call. Setup is paid in three milestones: at signing, at demo approval and at go-live. The exact split is in your proposal.

process.label: Prototype, then build
process.blurb: You approve a prototype first, then see a demo at each milestone, so you can change direction early.
process.detail: Your team signs off a prototype before the full build. For larger systems we start with one workflow and expand. You see a demo at each milestone and can change direction early.

process.label: Launch and training
process.blurb: I set it up and run a handover session, so your team knows how to use it from day one.
process.detail: I set it up and run a handover session so your team knows how to use it. If you need more, such as extra sessions or on-site training, it's quoted in your proposal.

process.label: After go-live
process.blurb: On a monthly plan it stays hosted, backed up and secure, with a review at 60–90 days.
process.detail: The monthly licence keeps it hosted, up and secure, with bug fixes. We review how it's being used at 60–90 days. Extra changes are quoted per request, with 10% off for plan clients.

nda: I'll sign an NDA before we talk if you want one.

faq.q: Our team isn't very tech-savvy. Will this work for us?
faq.a: Most likely. I keep the screens simple so teams pick them up quickly, and they work on a phone. A handover session is included in setup; extra or on-site training is quoted in your proposal. You'll need one person on your side who owns it day to day.

faq.q: Do we have to replace our current software?
faq.a: No. I usually work with the data your software already exports, like Excel or CSV files, so you keep what you use today.

You do, always, and you can export it in standard formats at any time. On a licence plan the software is licensed to you and I keep the code. You can buy the code outright, from month 12 or earlier by agreement, or choose Own the code from the start.

You get a full export of your data either way. If you own the code, you can leave any time, with no minimum period; services run to the end of the paid month. A monthly licence has a 6-month minimum from go-live, then 30 days' notice. If you need to leave a licence earlier, we agree it together; if you leave anyway, you choose between paying 2 months' fees or buying the code.

You do. I set up a dedicated WhatsApp Business number for your company, and someone on your side uses it day to day: staff send in entries, and you approve invoices and confirm records. If you'd rather not use WhatsApp, a simple portal does the same job. The automation only works if someone on your side is using it.
Access is limited by role, your data is backed up weekly as standard, and I'll sign an NDA if you want one. Daily backups are available as a paid add-on.
Automation takes 3–5 weeks, mobile apps 4–8 weeks, custom software 6–12 weeks and websites 3–5 weeks. The clock starts once you've sent your data and approvals. Your proposal will say exactly.

faq.q: Which AI do you use, and who pays for it?
faq.a: I use the latest models from leading AI providers, picked for each task. AI, API and WhatsApp message usage is included in your monthly fee up to ₹2,000 a month. Above that, it's billed at cost plus 15%, and I check with you first.

faq.q: Can I see a demo built for my business before committing?
faq.a: Yes. I can build a working demo around your own process and data, so you see exactly how it would work for you. It's priced as a small share of the estimated project fee, confirmed once we've discussed the scope of work (SOW).

faq.q: Can you build an app for millions of users?
faq.a: That's not what I focus on. I build systems for businesses and their teams, dealers and customers, from a handful of users up to around 50,000–100,000 monthly active users. I can also build MVPs designed to grow to that size. I'm a one-person studio, and that focus keeps your costs predictable and lets me give each client proper attention. If you're building a mass-market consumer app, a larger team will serve you better, and I'm happy to point you to one.
